last_tile_ordinary_comparator.name: last_tile_only_native_ID_wait
last_tile_ordinary_comparator.proposal_author: root; source/API/owner review by this Codex source seat
last_tile_ordinary_comparator.code_shape: retain all nonfinal-iteration wait_all; save RX_last and RY_last txids returned by the penultimate-iteration prefetch calls; final iteration waits dma_wait(id_x_last) and dma_wait(id_y_last) instead of wait_all; keep the existing final wait_all/fence/barriers
last_tile_ordinary_comparator.extra_state: two uint32_t dma_txid_t values, exactly 8 bytes of logical metadata; physical compiler register/spill cost unmeasured; same original four 2048B L1 slots
last_tile_ordinary_comparator.admission_n: at least two 512-float tiles for the proposed saved-last-prefetch form; for one tile retain original first/final wait_all (or save initial issue IDs separately and account that version)
owner_proof: At entry to final tile L-1, RX_last and RY_last fill parity (L-1)%2, while WY_(L-2) reads the opposite parity (L-2)%2.
The final iteration has rest=0 (S1:86,96): it issues no future input, so it never overwrites the older Y bank that the preceding output may still read.
The final FMA only reads X[(L-1)%2] and reads/writes Y[(L-1)%2]. Waiting for its named input transfers is the required data predecessor; it does not need old-output completion for its own operands.

The bottom barrier still precedes WY_last; the existing tail wait_all/fence/all-core barriers still precede dispatcher DONE, host cache handoff, consumer, unmap and free. Both Y banks remain live through their output obligations.
last_tile_ordinary_comparator.API_review: native helper returns dma_txid_t and native dma_wait(tid) is documented to wait for a transfer; the proposal uses those existing calls without new hardware or added buffer capacity
last_tile_ordinary_comparator.hardware_semantics_status: NOT_VERIFIED: helper decodes selector0 as completed_id and compares it to tid, but fixed RTL counter generation/update ordering, wrap/fault behavior and physical response meaning were not obtained in this bounded source set; no new submodule scan/retrieval undertaken
last_tile_ordinary_comparator.correctness_scope: conditional source ownership/API-contract proof only; no executed modified code; no claim both jobs actually remain pending concurrently, hardware wait_id excludes every later transfer, measurable overlap exists, or end-to-end net performance improves
last_tile_ordinary_comparator.intermediate_tile_warning: replacing all iteration wait_all calls by input-ID waits without a separate reuse guard is UNSAFE in general: publication of RY_(t+2) can overwrite Y[t%2] while WY_t is still reading it. Any general version must separately guard Y-bank reuse (and all-core barriers); last-tile-only version avoids the write because rest=0.
